memory.title: Deploy window
memory.abstract: Production deploys happen on Tuesdays and Thursdays only (sm-7731)
memory.content: Production deploys happen on Tuesdays and Thursdays only, because the on-call rotation covers those days.

memory.title: Billing currency
memory.abstract: Billing amounts are stored in minor units as integers (sm-7731)
memory.content: Billing amounts are stored in minor units as integers, never as floats, to avoid rounding drift.
